review_notes:
I read the whole file and checked how its declarations are used in AlgebraicGroupsTest/InfinitesimalAdditiveZero.lean. I also checked the related simp lemma infinitesimalAdditiveCoordinate_counit in InfinitesimalAdditive.lean.

The two @[simp] lemmas, `_apply` and `_symm_apply`, rewrite the equivalence to the native counit and algebra map. Both go from the opaque bundled equivalence to a canonical primitive. They cannot loop, and they combine with Bialgebra.counit_algebraMap and the existing simp lemma infinitesimalAdditiveCoordinate_counit. The `_coordinate` lemma is already provable by `simp`, so it doesn't need a simp attribute. The `_hom_left` and `_inv_left` rfl lemmas have cast-heavy Spec.map right-hand sides, so they are better as explicit readback lemmas than as simp rules.

I found no justified simp-interface defect. My only doubt is that I could not run Lean, so I didn't check the simp-set behaviour in downstream files beyond the test file.
